headline: KYURI IS A PRODUCT DESIGNER
WORKING ACROSS DIGITAL, UX
AND BRAND IDENTITY
paragraphs: I'm a Brand & Product Designer with roots in Industrial and Graphic Design. I design brand identities, typefaces, digital products, and physical objects.
I work by trying things: I explore, build, see what breaks, and keep going until the problem is solved. AI is often part of how I build.
